items.text: Mutilate's second main-hand proc chance was removed by the hotfix of 2026-11-21; the raid numbers here predate it.
Vampiric Embrace heals the party for 10% of your Shadow damage since client 1.60.1.71037 (20% before; you still get 20%); the raid numbers here predate it.
Windfury Totem's buff changed in client 1.60.1.71037 and the raid simulator used here predates it: full-raid numbers of melee builds assume the old totem.
